root_cause.text: The `mt7996_mac_write_txwi_80211` function in the mt7996 driver accesses management frame action fields (`mgmt->u.action`) without validating that the socket buffer (`skb`) length is sufficient to contain them.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1` before accessing `mgmt->u.action.category` and `mgmt->u.action.u.addba_req.action_code` in `drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7996/mac.c`.
